panel.name: panel_performance_autotune

check_box.name: FSAutoTuneImpostorByDistEnabled
check_box.label: Enable distance-based optimization
check_box.tool_tip: When enabled the viewer will adjust the MaxNonImpostors setting to limit fully rendered avatars to those within the defined radius.

panel.text: Distant avatars can be automatically optimized regardless of their render cost. Set the distance from camera beyond which an avatar will be optimized. Note: This setting will force MaxNonImpostors to 1 if nobody is nearby.
When adjusting scene parameters, autotune will choose values between the minimum and the preferred draw distances.

check_box.name: alow_self_impostor
check_box.label: Allow your own avatar to be optimized
check_box.tool_tip: When enabled the viewer may render your own avatar as an impostor.

check_box.name: show_tuned_art
check_box.label: Show optimized render time
check_box.tool_tip: When enabled the Time column shows the current render time not the pre-tuning render time.

panel.text: These options control more subtle settings. Use the online help page to get more information on what these do.
